purpose: First-pass capability atom ledger. This is intentionally representative, not exhaustive.

version_policy.expansion_policy: append AE2026/AE2027 as known_supported entries after fixtures, writers, and host-open policy are registered

boundaries: Writer targets are registered as data; future AE versions must extend the axis instead of replacing it.
Text layout equivalence may need render_compare when profile fields are insufficient.
Endpoint host-open inference may cover AE2021-AE2024 only when AE2020 and AE2025 direct host-open evidence passes.
Single-feature smoke artifacts under tmp/migration_shape_trim_paths are generated evidence and not the registry source of truth.
Effect matchName and parameter contracts should stay dictionary-backed instead of being inferred from filenames.

Owns the embedded built-in effect and effect-parameter template directory as a serializer source contract used by mutate_effect_add.go and mutate_effect_param.go; individual effect behaviors remain covered by recipe and matrix atoms.
Owns embedded project skeleton templates, including version-specific new-project seeds; detailed version behavior remains covered by project and migration matrix atoms.
Owns embedded layer-kind body templates as serializer source contracts; per-layer behavior remains covered by layer recipe and matrix atoms.
Owns embedded option-leaf templates for camera, light, mask, and material serialization; feature-level behavior remains covered by layer, mask, and material atoms.
Owns embedded vector shape body and leaf templates as serializer source contracts; individual shape primitives and filters remain covered by recipe and matrix atoms.
Owns embedded text animator and selector templates as serializer source contracts; individual text animator behavior remains covered by recipe and matrix atoms.
Explicit matte source is preserved for AE2025 targets and blocked for older writer targets by source contract.
PowerShell wrapper remains for host orchestration; new planning/audit tooling should prefer Go where practical.
Learning output must distinguish reusable source contracts from local corpus observations.
AI generation should consume registered atoms and workflows, not scrape tmp or flightdeck markdown directly.
